ruling: Item 37 rulings draft, section 19, which the owner confirmed as decided on 20 November 2026: "Cocaine's three transporter targets are curated (P4): SLC6A3 0.23, SLC6A4 0.74 and SLC6A2 0.48 micromolar, all inhibition so sign -1, each on ChEMBL binding records and Han and Gu 2006 (PMID 16515684, PMC1448202), with GtoPdb and Miller 2001 (PMID 11223167) as a third source for the dopamine transporter"; section 17, P4: "Cocaine's drug node is missing its principal targets (the dopamine, serotonin and noradrenaline transporters), which are curated from two sources by a Fable pass before any merge is ruled on"
sources: Han DD and Gu HH 2006, BMC Pharmacology 6:6 (PMID 16515684, PMC1448202, doi 10.1186/1471-2210-6-6), full text read at PMC, Table 1: human DAT KI 0.23 +/- 0.03 uM (mean +/- SEM, n = 4 to 7; human DAT, NET and SERT cDNAs transiently expressed in monkey Intestine 407 cells, [3H]-substrate uptake inhibition, KI from IC50 by Cheng-Prusoff); ChEMBL binding records of cocaine (parent CHEMBL370805) at the human single-protein target CHEMBL238 "Sodium-dependent dopamine transporter", read through the ChEMBL connector (ChEMBL_34 by its banner): Ki rows of 32 to 1270 nM over 32 rows, the human recombinant rows (HEK293, COS-7) at about 200 to 760 nM, and one 2024 row (CHEMBL5539187) giving the action type INHIBITOR; third, for the dopamine transporter only: GtoPdb ligand 2286, interactions at target 927 (rat, Inhibitor, pKi 7.1, primary target), matched by Miller et al. 2001, Brain Res Mol Brain Res 87:124-43 (PMID 11223167, abstract only: wild-type DAT cocaine IC50 79 +/- 8.2 nM); as recorded by the Fable pass of 19 November 2026 (cocaine_targets_2026-11-19.md in that session's scratchpad)
note: Recorded as an omission, not a contradiction (rulings draft, section 19): the FDA cocaine hydrochloride labels (Goprelto, Numbrino and two further nasal SPLs, read through openFDA) give the mechanism as the sodium-channel action alone and are silent on the three transporters, so the label is not a second source for them. The 32 nM ChEMBL row is rat caudate-putamen binding mapped to the human record (assay CHEMBL872503), and GtoPdb's pKi 7.1 is a rat value; the human value of Han and Gu is the one carried. ChEMBL curates no transporter mechanism for cocaine (its one mechanism row is mec 8842, the sodium-channel family CHEMBL2331043), which is why the row is an addition. The affinity is recorded for the occupancy weighting of amendment item 37 (37h, 37i), which is not built; until it is, the target takes magnitude 1 like every mechanism target. The KI is the authors' Cheng-Prusoff conversion of an uptake IC50, recorded as Ki as the paper reports it.
